_comment: One Usage-category resource per metered product, plus one Currency-category resource for the spend commitment (the org's own QB-MTY-CMT sample has exactly this shape). Every UsageDefinitionProductId points FORWARD at a product in 06; rc-config fills it in once the product exists.

records.Description: One per m3ter meter `document_report_standard_hybrid` (aggregation `document_report_standard_hybrid_count`); rated per check on the EUR rate card.
